title: einvoice conformance receipt (v1)
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for the deterministic EN 16931 / XRechnung conformance receipt produced by `python3 -m einvoice receipt` / `einvoice.receipt.build_receipt`. This is the machine-checkable companion to the `RECEIPT_FORMAT` constant in einvoice/receipt.py and to RECEIPT-VERIFICATION.md / REPORT-SCHEMA.md. The receipt is the canonical, byte-stable attestation of a single validation outcome: an envelope `{receipt: <body>, content_sha256: <hex>}` where `content_sha256` is the SHA-256 of the canonicalized body (json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')), UTF-8). The body carries no rule logic of its own — verdict/well_formed/failed_fatal_rules are a deterministic projection of einvoice.validate.validate_file. Versioning policy: this `$id` and the body `format` const are STABLE within v1 — additive, backward-compatible fields (e.g. the optional `issued_at`) may be present without changing them; any BREAKING change to the receipt shape bumps the id (and RECEIPT_FORMAT) to `.../v2`. Shape note: the body always carries the seven core fields; `issued_at` is OPTIONAL and present only when a caller passes it explicitly (it is then part of the hashed body).

receipt.description: The attested body. Its canonical serialization is what `content_sha256` hashes.

format.description: Stable receipt-format id; bound to RECEIPT_FORMAT in einvoice/receipt.py. Consumers should match on this exact string.

tool.description: The validator's identity: its import/console name and the single-source-of-truth package version (einvoice.__version__ — never a second hardcoded copy).

profile.description: The rule-set id used: 'en16931' core, or 'xrechnung' (core + the German BR-DE-* CIUS).

well_formed.description: True iff the input parsed as well-formed XML. False when the input is not well-formed (the receipt is still emitted, with an 'S-WF' fatal entry and verdict FAIL).

verdict.description: 'PASS' iff no fatal rule failed, else 'FAIL' (official Schematron flag semantics: only fatal violations invalidate a document).

input_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the input document's raw bytes.

failed_fatal_rules.description: The fatal rule ids that failed, each with its human message, in the validator's deterministic rule-evaluation order. Empty list on a PASS.

rule.description: The fatal rule id, e.g. 'BR-02', 'BR-CL-01', 'S-ROOT', or 'S-WF' on the not-well-formed path.

issued_at.description: OPTIONAL. Present ONLY when a caller passes it explicitly; it is then copied verbatim into the hashed body (a different timestamp is a different receipt). Absent by default so the receipt is fully deterministic with no wall-clock leak. Documented as an ISO 8601 timestamp string.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonicalized body (json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) encoded UTF-8). Changes iff the body changes.
